changeSet.author: gboyeguntaiwo
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_enrollment SET gaweeks = FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0), last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_FIX' WHERE archived = false AND lmp IS NOT NULL AND pmtct_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND gaweeks IS NOT NULL AND gaweeks > 0 -- Only update records where calculated GA is valid (4-45 weeks) AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) BETWEEN 4 AND 45 -- Only update if stored GA differs from calculated GA AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) != gaweeks;

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: UPDATE pmtct_enrollment SET gaweeks = FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0), last_modified_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_modified_by = 'SYSTEM_GA_FIX' WHERE archived = false AND lmp IS NOT NULL AND pmtct_enrollment_date IS NOT NULL AND (gaweeks IS NULL OR gaweeks = 0) -- Only update if calculated GA is valid (4-45 weeks) AND FLOOR((pmtct_enrollment_date - lmp) / 7.0) BETWEEN 4 AND 45;
